decision.reason: [ev-0b599c9a3d11] is a one-line highlight saying OpenTelemetry tracing was added for both Kustomization and HelmRelease reconciliation and is set up through a `Provider`. The proposed exposure, gvk-in-use HelmRelease, is wrong in two ways. It leaves out Kustomization. It also flags every HelmRelease user, even though the note ties tracing to a Provider that has to be configured. To write a correct condition, I would need evidence that names the Provider API group and kind, and the field or type value that turns on tracing (for example, a Provider type set to an OpenTelemetry value). I would also need the API groups for both kinds, since the excerpt gives neither.
